name: pokemon-card-index
description: Every English and Japanese Pokémon TCG card in one offline, instantly searchable page, with prices.

scripts.build: mkdir -p build && node scripts/build-catalog.js build/sources build/catalog.json && node scripts/merge-pricecharting.js data/pricecharting build/pc_data.json && node scripts/assemble.js
scripts.refresh: npm run sources && npm run build
